scope: Bounded Q12 presentation-only native review of an existing completed GCP result in light/dark and large simulator text size; not Q12-complete or BIZQ-01 acceptance.

criteria.q12Source: BIZQ-01 §6, Q12: large text, light/dark, long options; options and Details readable and actions remain available; no VoiceOver test.
coveredByPlan: Read-only completed review result, not a new answer/session.
Light and dark via simulator appearance while app preference remains System.
Maximum selected simulator content-size category, with actual app text capped by maxFontSizeMultiplier=2.
Wrong authored diagnostic, expanded Details/source content, a correct neighboring review item, persistent review actions and return to the existing result.
Exact original simulator appearance/content-size restoration and read-back.
explicitlyNotCovered: Long repaired option presentation: the existing GCP options are moderately short.

A repaired-question partial response: the existing completed GCP session has no partial answer and current free-Coding selector does not naturally select a partial-capable question in its empty-history 10/20/40 sessions.
Premium/OOD admission, VoiceOver, Q13 active package update, full Q12, full BIZQ-01, or release readiness.

reasons: The source path is an existing saved certification result and review projection, using the actual common feedback, Details, and review-navigation components.
System appearance delegates to React Native useColorScheme; simulator-only appearance changes do not require saving an app preference.
The proposal is scoped to actual visible Q12 concerns and preserves the GCP goal/plan/attempt by not creating a session, changing track, or modifying answers.
Existing package 27 acceptance is PASS for its bounded scoring slice and explicitly does not claim full Q12.
assessment.nonblockingClarification: At the maximum simulator category, source components cap text with maxFontSizeMultiplier=2. Report the selected simulator category and screenshot as the app's capped supported text size; do not imply unbounded text growth.
risksAndControls: Temporary simulator appearance/content-size override is controlled by root, restored in a finally/trap path to exact initial dark/large, then verified by read-only query.
Screenshots can establish only the variants and visible content actually inspected; they do not prove VoiceOver, repaired long-option behavior, or partial-answer behavior.
If content is below the viewport, scroll to verify it and the sticky navigation; no requirement is inferred that all content fit above the fold.

reviewBoundaries.prerequisite: Root confirms the package 27 acceptance/push sequence before device execution.
